newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: CENTRAL BANK, SOCGEN DISCUSS BRANCH OFFICE.
newsitem.headline: CENTRAL BANK, SOCGEN DISCUSS BRANCH OFFICE.

text.p: Central bank governor Reinoldijus Sharkinas on Thursday met Societe Generale CIS and Baltic area manager Denis Davidoff to discuss the possibility of SocGen opening a branch office in Lithuania this year.
"The French bank was interested in the situation in the Lithuanian financial market," a central bank spokeswoman told Reuters.
"The Societe Generale delegation and the Bank of Lithuania governor discussed the possibilities to open a branch office in Lithuania this year," the spokeswoman added.
The two men also discussed the central bank's monetary policy and the banking sector.
She said that no concrete dates were set and that talks would continue in the future.
